unit: by year (match-clean) and by time (train early, test late)
rationale: Chronological split, train-early/test-late, to respect ability drift. Boundaries fall on year gaps so no match spans folds (match-clean by construction). Coverage is uneven: TRAIN 2011-2018 has all four slams per year; VAL 2019-2020 is missing 2020 Wimbledon; TEST 2021-2024 has all four in 2021 but only two slams each in 2022-2024, skewing the late test years toward grass/hard. Consequence: never compare raw rates across folds without conditioning on slam x year fixed effects, and report per-slam cross-checks. The split is frozen once written; the test fold is the only out-of-sample period available and Stage 0 does not touch it.
frozen_dataset: slam point-by-point ends 2024-10; test fold is the only OOS period this project will ever have -- declared once, never re-split.
